Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Attached is our draft Mutual Alignment Plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation success criteria to concrete acceptance tests and a close timeline. I pulled together the bits we discussed so the execs and engineering can align quickly.

High-level asks (please):
- Please confirm the priority success signals by Tue 5/19 so we can lock test owners.
- Can you share the procurement target date for MSA + PO? You mentioned end of June — is that still accurate?
- Security: is SOC2 Type II evidence required before pilot signoff, or is a remediation plan + audit timeline acceptable?

Proposed acceptance summary (see MAP sheet tab 'Acceptance'):
1) Functional correctness: end-to-end task passrate >= 92% on the provided prompt suite (50 core prompts + 30 failure modes). Owner: Evelyn / Product.
2) Latency SLO: p95 generation latency <= 150ms for 256-token average sequence; degradations must fall back to constrained model within 300ms. Owner: Redwood infra (Marcus).
3) Cost signal: avg cost/token under the pilot budget target (TBD) — measured across 2-week window. Owner: Finance/Procurement.
4) Safety/Compliance gating: no critical data exfiltration incidents during trial; audit log retention validated. Owner: Security (Laura).

Acceptance tests we recommend in the MAP (technical):
- Smoke test A: single-user 5-min load ramp to validate latency and prefix-KV cache warmup (owner: Marcus).
- Smoke test B: adversarial prompt set (30 prompts) for false-positive hallucination checks (owner: Evelyn/Product).
- Regression harness: 1000 prompt regression run comparing current model to baseline for token-level concordance (owner: Redwood QA).

Timeline:
- 5/19: MAP sign-off (mutual).
- 5/22–6/04: Engineering/test runs + security evidence handoff.
- 6/07: Final acceptance run; week-of 6/10 target for deal close (subject to PO).

I attached MAP-draft-2026-05-16.xlsx and a short security-evidence-summary PDF to this thread.

Thanks — talk soon.

Hi Evelyn / Soojin —

Quick technical proposal to close the gaps Evelyn flagged. Pulling directly from the MAP 'Tests' tab (proposed thresholds):
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms at nominal 256-token workload. Measured at endpoint with TLS. Failure = p95 > 200ms over a 24h window.
- Throughput: sustained 80 RPS per GPU pod for mixed request shapes with an 80/20 gen/chat ratio. If your production shape is heavier, we can tune the batching profile; please send sample traffic shape by 5/20.
- Regression concordance: token-level agreement >= 95% versus model: redwood/redwood-v2-small@2026-04-01 (baseline). We will provide the harness and runbook; outcome is a pass/fail.
- Safety checks: adversarial prompt set must not return PII extraction > 0.5% on sample. We'll provide the scripts; validation owner: Evelyn/Product.

Test owners and deliverables (short):
- Marcus (Redwood Infra): smoke test harness, YAML runbook, kernel/quantization profile to be used. Deliverable by 5/28.
- Redwood QA: regression harness + results dashboard by 6/06.
- Evelyn/Product: review failure-mode labels and run adversarial set by 6/02.
- Laura (Security): confirm acceptable audit log retention policy and whether interim SOC2 artifacts suffice.

If this looks good I can attach a short runbook stub (kernel-config.json, run-harness.sh) and mark the MAP as 'engineer-ready' for 5/22.
